assignments.reason: This node describes the human act of studying Torah or praying with fear and love (דחילו ורחימו). Its essential nature is the activation of sacred speech — the very domain that Package 1 represents. The Torah text situates this act as the moment when the breath-of-the-mouth (הבל פה) and the voice (קול) are engaged with devotion. The node is not merely causally connected to the breath/letter-Heh domain; it IS the lived engagement of that domain. Prayer and study with awe and love are the human activation of the הבל פה — the primordial sacred breath that is the letter Heh. Good polarity: this is a holy act directed toward revealing God's kingship.

This node names the revelation of the upper letters Yud-Heh of the divine Name. Its essential nature is the letters of the divine Name — the same ontological domain as אות ה"א (the letter Heh already in Package 1). The Heh of Package 1 is the lower Heh of the Name (breath/mouth), while Yud-Heh are the upper concealed pair; together they form the complete Name-letter structure that is the core identity of this package. The node belongs here by its essential nature as a dimension of the divine Name's letter-structure, not merely because it is causally produced by prayer. Good polarity: the revelation of God's concealed Name-letters is squarely in the domain of holiness.
